en.description:
Play One, Two, Three, a fast, colorful card game made for Apple Watch. Challenge the CPU in quick rounds that fit your day: a coffee break, a walk, or a moment between tasks, all from your wrist.

The game pairs simple rules with a punchy retro arcade look: chunky pixel UI, high-contrast colors, and clear feedback so everything stays readable on a small screen.

NEW TO THE GAME?
Walk through a built-in tutorial that explains the deck, turns, special catches, and penalties step by step. You’ll pick up the flow without digging through a manual.

TAILOR THE CHALLENGE
Choose a difficulty that matches how you like to play, from a more relaxed pace to a tighter CPU. Switch language in Settings so the interface matches how you read best.

BUILT FOR THE WATCH
Designed around short sessions and taps on your Apple Watch. No need to lean on your phone for the core experience—just launch and play.

• Arcade-inspired visuals and crisp, watch-friendly layout  
• Interactive tutorial for rules and combo moments  
• Adjustable difficulty  
• Local play on your device, great when you want a quick game offline  
• Free to download and enjoy  

Whether you love retro games, card mechanics, or finding something fun on your Apple Watch beyond notifications, One, Two, Three is built to deliver bite-sized matches with personality.

Have feedback or ideas? Leave a review; your notes help shape future updates.
